# uptimeify_im_team (Data Source)

Look up one Incident Management team by `id` or by `name` (exactly one). Fails when no or several teams match the name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uptimeify_im_team" "platform" {
  name = "Platform"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Numeric team id.
- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `analytics_enabled` (Boolean)
- `created_at` (String)
- `engagement_report_day_of_week` (Number)
- `engagement_report_enabled` (Boolean)
- `engagement_report_time` (String)
- `escalation_repeats` (Number)
- `escalation_repeats_after_minutes` (Number)
- `escalation_repeats_stop_mode` (String)
- `label_color` (String)
- `organization_id` (Number)
- `timezone` (String)
